skill.name: context7-auto-research
skill.description: Fetches current library and framework documentation through Context7 to support Claude Code and related AI coding workflows.
skill.summary: Researches current Context7 documentation before answering library and framework questions.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives. SKILL.md is a prompt-only Markdown file; the flagged bash fence and GitHub URL are documentation references.

finding_verdicts.reason: The finding points to a Markdown fenced bash block for manual installation, not executable skill code. The skill has no scripts or runtime hooks.
The URL is a Markdown link to a GitHub repository for examples. It does not perform a network request during skill use.

content.value_statement: Library answers can become outdated when frameworks change. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code request current Context7 documentation before answering.
actual_capabilities: Triggers research when a prompt asks about current library or framework documentation.
Uses Context7 documentation as the stated source for library research.
Supports common framework questions, including React, Next.js, and Prisma.
Guides Claude Code conversations toward current documentation before implementation advice.
Documents optional API key setup for higher Context7 rate limits.
limitations: It does not replace local testing or environment-specific validation.
It depends on Context7 availability and documentation coverage.
It needs clear library names or enough context to choose documentation.
It cannot guarantee that every upstream documentation page is complete.

use_cases.title: Update Framework Answers
use_cases.description: Check current React, Next.js, or Prisma behavior before changing production code.

use_cases.title: Prepare Migration Guidance
use_cases.description: Ground upgrade notes in current framework documentation before planning a migration.

use_cases.title: Review Generated Code
use_cases.description: Ask for current API references when reviewing generated implementation suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Check Current Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use context7-auto-research to check the current documentation for React hooks before answering my question.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Framework Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Research current Next.js documentation for routing and data loading, then compare the supported options for this feature.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Implementation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Before recommending code changes, research the current Prisma documentation for transactions and note any version-specific constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Build Documentation-Grounded Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Research current documentation for Next.js, React, and Prisma, then review this architecture plan for outdated API assumptions.

output_examples.input: How should I fetch data in the current Next.js app router?
output_examples.output: The response references current Next.js documentation, explains supported data loading choices, and lists version-specific cautions.

output_examples.input: Review my Prisma transaction plan before I implement it.
output_examples.output: The response checks current Prisma transaction guidance, highlights supported patterns, and flags assumptions that need local testing.

best_practices: Name the library, framework, and version when you know them.
Ask for documentation citations before accepting version-sensitive guidance.
Validate the final answer with tests in your target environment.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for topics unrelated to library or framework documentation.
Do not treat documentation research as a substitute for security review.
Do not omit version details when your project depends on specific behavior.

faq.question: Does this skill execute code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill file is Markdown instructions and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: What tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What is Context7 used for?
faq.answer: Context7 is the stated documentation source for current library and framework research.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The skill notes optional API key configuration for higher rate limits.

faq.question: Which libraries fit best?
faq.answer: It is suited to active frameworks and libraries such as React, Next.js, and Prisma.

faq.question: Can it replace testing?
faq.answer: No. Use it to improve guidance, then validate changes in your own environment.
